_que_es: Traduccion al ingles de lo que el usuario ve de cada skill en docs/skills.en.md y en la web: el nombre de cada grupo y el campo when (cuando usarla) de core/skills-registry.json. El contenido de la skill NO se traduce (lo lee el agente). build-docs avisa y cae al castellano si falta una; test-i18n exige que esten todas.

when.project-planner: Starting a project or feature, planning, "what do we do now?", next task; and ALWAYS when plan/PLAN.md exists (the plan is followed)
when.code-quality: Writing or refactoring logic, writing tests, handling errors/logs, security, performance, designing endpoints/APIs, reviewing or opening a PR
when.backend-audit: Auditing backend and architecture with proof (tools per stack, evidence per finding, report), technical debt, legacy code, circular dependencies and safe refactoring with characterization tests
when.depurar: Something fails or does not work (failing tests, exception, 500 error, wrong result): method to reproduce, write a failing test, form hypotheses, narrow it down and fix the root cause
when.ddd-hexagonal: Module with rich business rules, several contexts, architecture refactor away from MVC, "how do I structure this?" (start with its "do I need it?" checklist)
when.devlog: Finishing a relevant step or committing (always); questions about the project's past (memory and search)
when.ui-ux-pro-max: Creating, laying out or redesigning pages, views, layouts, components, forms, dashboards, themes, colors, typography, icons, responsive design, accessibility; .vue .tsx .jsx .astro .blade.php .html .css files
when.ui-styling: shadcn/ui components (React or Vue) and Tailwind utilities/theme
when.design-system: Design tokens (primitive → semantic → component), CSS variables, token validation
when.gsap-scrolltrigger: Animation, scroll-driven effects, parallax, pin/scrub, timelines, page transitions, smooth scroll (Lenis)
when.motion-framer: Declarative animation in React/Next with Motion (variants, gestures, layout animations)
when.scroll-reveal-libraries: Simple scroll reveals (AOS) on landing pages
when.animated-component-libraries: Ready-made animated components (Magic UI, React Bits)
when.threejs-webgl: 3D, WebGL/WebGPU, GLB/GLTF models, shaders, particles, configurators, 3D heroes
when.web3d-integration-patterns: Combining Three.js + GSAP + R3F + Motion in complex 3D experiences
when.blender-web-pipeline: Exporting/optimizing Blender models to glTF for the web
when.spline-interactive: Scenes built in Spline and their integration into the web
when.substance-3d-texturing: PBR texturing with Substance 3D for the web
when.modern-web-design: Modern web design trends and principles
when.graphic-design: Logos, icons, corporate identity, mockups (AI generation)
when.brand: Brand voice, visual identity, brand guidelines
when.banner-design: Banners for social media, ads and heroes
when.skill-router: Starting any non-trivial task: decides which skill and section to read (activation table + loading protocol)
when.instalar-proyecto: Installing or updating the full Senzu in the project (/install): everything, by category or custom
when.front-activation: Starting a UI, animation or 3D task: detects the front-end profile and the minimum reading per task; specific effects from the catalog (modern CSS, shapes and SVG, kinetic typography, microinteractions, advanced WebGL, physics and impact: falling objects, broken screen, intros and loaders)
when.ui-verify: Verifying a finished UI in a real browser: responsive 375/768/1440, dark mode, console and accessibility (axe); required before a view is considered done
when.image-gen: Generating AI images that match the website: floating product, heroes, backgrounds, 3D, mockups, textures (gpt-image in Codex, Nano Banana in Antigravity, multi-provider script)
when.marketing-seo: Ranking and measuring the website: on-page and local SEO, keywords, Search Console, GA4, Google Tag Manager (container, dataLayer, Consent Mode) and analytics MCPs for agents to operate
when.email-html: Building or fixing HTML emails (transactional and newsletters): react-email/MJML/framework templates, Gmail/Outlook compatibility, dark mode, plain text and testing before sending
when.deploy-ops: Deploying and running any stack in production: Netlify/Vercel/Forge/VPS, Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, per-environment secrets, queues and cron in prod, backups with tested restores, monitoring and incidents
when.tanstack: Server state (fetching, caching, invalidation, infinite queries), tables with sorting/filtering/pagination (client or server side), virtualization of large lists; dashboards and data tables (React, Vue, Svelte, Solid)
when.security: Reviewing or auditing the project's security, hardening auth / an API / an AI agent, hardening, authorized pentesting, OWASP, prompt injection, XSS/CSRF/SSRF/IDOR, security headers
